description: 前薄后厚波浪大底、皮面网布拼接鞋面、系带男女通用运动休闲鞋

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant rows, fresh outdoor lawn-green #6FA84C scenes, warm off-white #FAF7F2 and light matte board #EFEAE3 for infographic panels, deep charcoal #26262A for the sole detail, one accent red #D8342A closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright daylight-balanced studio light with a front-left key and soft contact shadows for packshots; sunny morning outdoor light around 5200-5300K with one clear shadow direction for scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: short fresh lawn grass, light matte studio board, warm off-white infographic board, hard grey pavement for pain-point context
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin red #D8342A underline bar motif, short headlines and labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line sport icons, single accent color, low complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for packshots; shoe always grounded with a contact shadow, never floating; product never covered by props or text
noDrift: no lighting drift between variant colorways
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent energetic casual-sports footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2B2B2B, fresh lawn green #6FA84C and one vivid red accent #D8342A; bright daylight-balanced lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows, outdoor shots in sunny morning light; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin red underline bar motif; consistent thin-line sport icons; clean high-end sneaker photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for packshots with balanced natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The shoe centered at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, upright on its outsole with the whole silhouette visible, occupying 35-40% of the frame with the clean white #FFFFFF field completing the composition around it. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the shoe. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background, no floating shoe, no cut-off edges.

shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing mesh weave and leather grain
shots.whitespace: minimal, around 15%, texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the upper where smooth synthetic leather panels meet breathable woven mesh along a double-stitched seam. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with the stitching in sharp focus. Raking side light from the right revealing the mesh weave texture and the leather grain. Neutral matte light board background #EFEAE3. The material detail fills 55-60% of the frame; keep only about 15% clean margin since the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no props.
